Reference / http/auth

http/auth#

Client authentication: Basic (RFC 7617) and Bearer (RFC 6750) credentials, sent only inside a scope.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let api = BearerExchanging(
    origin: HttpClient(),
    scope: ParsedUrl("https://api.example.com/v1/").parts(),
    authorization: BearerAuthorization(token),
);
await api.response(Request(url: "https://api.example.com/v1/items"));

Description#

Client authentication: Basic (RFC 7617) and Bearer (RFC 6750) credentials, sent only inside a scope.

The scope is an https URL: the credentials go to the same scheme, host and port, under the scope's path, and never through a redirect elsewhere. Secrets are SecretBytes and do not show in diagnostics. Digest authentication is in http/digest.
